dialogues.speaker: Automated Telemetry
dialogues.text: WARNING: Temporal containment flux detected in Sector 0. Causal shear exceeding 40 millichrons.

dialogues.speaker: Past Self
dialogues.text: The containment ring is vibrating violently. The terminal is receiving an encrypted transmission signed with my own biometrics.

dialogues.speaker: Encrypted Transmission
dialogues.text: Execute the emergency lockdown immediately. Do not hesitate. If you delay, the breach propagates forward.

choices.text: Delay lockdown and initiate personnel evacuation

dialogues.speaker: Past Self
dialogues.text: The blast doors slam shut with finality. The telemetry stabilizes, but the silence from the inner ring is deafening.

dialogues.speaker: Terminal Log
dialogues.text: Quarantine established. Causal wave contained. Timeline anchor holding at 95%.

dialogues.speaker: Past Self
dialogues.text: Sirens wail through the transit tunnels. Colleagues flee toward the surface lifts as temporal tremors fracture the floor beneath our feet.

dialogues.speaker: Terminal Log
dialogues.text: Containment delayed. Unstable temporal echo recorded. Timeline anchor degraded to 75%.
